rawContent: BREAKING: Syukuoro Manabe and Klaus Hasselman take home half the #NobelPrize in Physics for #climate modeling, and the other half goes to Giorgio Parisi @giorgioparisi for studies of disordered systems. More coming soon: https://t.co/RjIs29A189

#Climate modelling took home half the physics #NobelPrize today. This year’s @IPCC_CH #ClimateChange report paints a dire future, some effects being unavoidable. But the world still has the opportunity to head off more extreme average temperature increases https://t.co/Mad6cq6tc6

The science behind today's #NobelPrize in physics helped us understand how increasing CO₂ levels changes #climate. To lower those levels, we need to make air travel more sustainable. Here's how some airlines might do it: https://t.co/EVjxOCZk9h
